description: Salesforce Lightning navigation with aria-labeled buttons
criticalFeatures: Aria-label matching - must match exact aria-label text
NEAREST_SECTION scope - must handle section-based scoping
Button disambiguation - must not confuse with 'Remove favorite' or 'Add to Favorites'
Scope filtering with aria-label override - even if scope doesn't match, aria-label should include element
regressionTests: CandidateFinder should find button with aria-label='Show Navigation Menu'
CandidateFinder should NOT select 'Remove favorite' button
Scope filter should include elements matching recordedAriaLabel even if scopePath doesn't match
When multiple sections have same button, scope hint should prefer correct section
knownBugs: FIXED: Scope filtering was excluding correct button because scopePath didn't match
FIXED: computeAccessibleName was returning empty for aria-labeled buttons
